_comment: Every `continue-on-error` site under .github/workflows/ (*.yml and *.yaml) and .github/actions/**/action.{yml,yaml}, with the reason it may read green without proving it evaluated anything (#4518). Nothing is excluded by file: a `floored` row names the step in the site's own job that carries the floor and the exact text proving it, which must sit in the argument list of a named measuring invocation (scripts/assert-evaluated.mjs, scripts/smoke-tools.mjs, scripts/complexity-report.mjs) on a top-level line the shell executes, so a printed command, a function or block body, a subshell, a chained command and a line after an exit all credit nothing; the floor step must NOT be continue-on-error, must come after the site, and its `if:` must be absent or a conjunction of always(), success(), !cancelled() and one github.event_name or matrix.<name> comparison the parsed document settles (the workflow's on: keys, that job's strategy.matrix list), so `!cancelled() && matrix.os == 'macos-latest'` counts only where the matrix declares that leg (every other expression, including a trivially true literal and a comparison no declared value satisfies, leaves the floor unproven, and so does a job whose own `if:` the document proves never true). A `\`-continued line and a line the previous one left unfinished with &&, || or | are one command, so the measuring invocation must start the joined command, and an exit ends the script only in command position. A `no-floor` row states the reader that makes an empty result visible instead. A `governed-by` row names the issue and the tests that own the site. tests/config/nightly-evaluated-floors.test.ts derives the population from the parsed files (a deep walk of the document, so a `continue-on-error` inside a `run:` heredoc is text, not a key) and fails closed on: an unregistered site, a registered row with no site, a continue-on-error key at a location the reader does not classify, a producer file the reader does not classify, an unparseable producer file, and a non-file entry (a symlink or a directory named like a workflow). Measured floors behind the `floored` rows live in measurements.json (nonLspFloors) where a run measured them.

.github/workflows/ci.yml#install-test#PO.reason: The anchors stay advisory about test RESULTS, and the non-continue-on-error floor step below them reds the leg when fewer than 100 tests executed (223 on the measured macOS leg; measurements.json nonLspFloors).

.github/workflows/ci.yml#install-test#Ru.reason: The reporter runs scripts/validate-rule-catalog.mjs over rules/rule-catalog.json and the rule trees, both checked in, and exits non-zero on drift. tests/scripts/rule-language-case.test.ts spawns the same script on fixture repos and asserts its findings in the gating Unit lane, so a validator that stopped reporting cannot pass unnoticed.

.github/workflows/ci.yml#changed-tests-s.reason: A pull request that adds or changes no test file legitimately shuffles zero files, so a count floor would red a docs-only PR. scripts/ci-shuffle-changed-tests.mjs prints 'no test file added or changed' for that case, exits 3 (unproven) when a vitest start answers 'No test files found' or never finishes, the job is advisory by its name suffix, and a job-level continue-on-error still lets its check row read failure.

.github/workflows/compat-smoke.yml#compa.reason: The alert job reads its step outcome. Any non-success (contract drift, an infra failure, or a crash before it verified anything) files or refreshes ONE tracking issue by fixed title, and a green run closes that issue, so an empty layer is never silent.
The alert job reads its step outcome the same way as Layer A: a crash, a failed install or a wrong light-mode decision files or refreshes the tracking issue, and a clean run closes it.

Tracker maintenance. Gating the notifier would let an issue-upsert failure mask the smoke's own verdict, which the job outputs already carry; a failed upsert shows as this step's outcome in the run log.

.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml#host.reason: Tracker maintenance. The notifier reads all eight host-latest-smoke step outcomes, files or refreshes the tracker on any failure and closes it on green; gating the gh upsert itself would mask the lane's verdict.
Its step outcome reaches host-latest-notify through the job outputs. A failed dist build files or refreshes the tracker issue by fixed title, and a clean run closes it.

.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml#lsp-.floorStep: LSP handshake layer (install + spawn + initialize each server)
.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml#lsp-.reason: The job stays advisory (continue-on-error plus its name suffix), and its one graded step carries --min-pass=35: an unavailable server reports a skipped row, never a failure, so a run where every toolchain install failed would exit 0 having proved nothing. 35 sits under both measured PR runs (41 and 40; measurements.json nonLspFloors).

A toolchain install. An absent Elixir reports skipped handshake rows (run 38641583432), which the --min-pass=35 floor counts, so gating the install would red a PR for a runner-image change rather than for pi-lens.

.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml#mise.reason: A leg either runs the whole pi session through scripts/rpc-load-check.mjs or its step exits non-zero, so 'evaluated nothing' has no green spelling: a leg that installed nothing has no pi for the last step to drive. The header above the job in install-smoke.yml states this, and the failing leg's check row is the signal.

.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml#scop.reason: A fail-open classifier, not a producer. A failed job leaves outputs.smoke empty, and pi-load reads empty as 'not false', so the full matrix runs: the green path cannot skip the work this job scopes.

.github/workflows/lint.yml#complexity.reason: scripts/complexity-report.mjs calls the shared assertEvaluated with COMPLEXITY_ANALYZED_FILES_FLOOR, so a run that analyses too few source files exits non-zero and the graded step reds; set -o pipefail keeps a crash behind the pipe from reading green.

.github/workflows/lint.yml#jscpd.reason: jscpd's exit code is the whole verdict (threshold 1) over four fixed in-repo paths: a missing path exits 1, and only a .jscpd.json format or ignore edit can empty the scan. The header above the job in lint.yml states this.

.github/workflows/lint.yml#strictness.reason: The job only publishes the two tsc counts. The gating tests/config/strictness-ratchet.test.ts runs the same two configurations and reds on exit 0, zero diagnostics or any drift, so a tsc that evaluated nothing reds the Unit lane. The header above the job states this.

.github/workflows/lint.yml#taplo.reason: npm run taplo feeds git ls-files '*.toml' to taplo, which exits non-zero on a parse error or format drift; only a pathspec edit can empty the match. The header above the job states this.

.github/workflows/lint.yml#typos.reason: crate-ci/typos walks the checkout and exits non-zero on any finding or error; the population is the repo itself and cannot be empty. The header above the job states this.

.github/workflows/lint.yml#yamllint.reason: The file list is git ls-files of the checkout, and yamllint with an empty list exits 2 (usage), so an empty population reds the row instead of reading clean. The header above the job states this.

.github/workflows/parser-smoke.yml#parse.reason: A cache-write step (mode: save). The graded step above it carries --min-pass=11, and losing the cache costs a cold install on the next run, not a verdict.

.github/workflows/stryker-nightly.yml#mu.reason: Exploratory by design and gates nothing (#4005). The gating 'Fail the shard when the driver failed' step turns a failed shard red, and scripts/stryker-nightly.mjs combine classifies a shard with no report, another shard's report or an unreadable report as failed and lists every incomplete range in the tracking-issue body.

.github/workflows/stryker-pertest.yml#mu.floorStep: List tests that kill no mutant
.github/workflows/stryker-pertest.yml#mu.reason: The mutant count is the verdict, not the report's presence: Stryker writes {"files":{}} and exits 0 for a range with nothing to mutate, so the always() candidates step judges the count through assert-evaluated.mjs --floor 1 and its exit status reds the run. Pinned by tests/scripts/floor-steps-executed.test.ts.

.github/workflows/tool-smoke.yml#snapsho.reason: Tracker maintenance, not a producer: snapshot-persist-bench's own step outcome and drift state are the verdict, and this job only files, refreshes or closes the tracking issue by fixed title.
Tracker maintenance over the bench's drift state: the bench step carries the verdict, and a missing state file leaves the issue untouched rather than reading clean.

.github/workflows/tool-smoke.yml#test-hi.reason: Tracker maintenance, not a producer: the test-history rollup and publish steps' own outcomes are the verdict, and this job only files or refreshes the #4030 tracking issue. Gating the issue upsert here would mask the rollup's failure instead of reporting it.

.github/workflows/tool-smoke.yml#tool-sm.reason: Its step outcome gates the refresh PR through needs.tool-smoke.outputs.census (the PR step runs only on 'success'), and 'Notify on LSP capability census' files one tracking issue on any failure, so a red census is visible even though it cannot fail the nightly.

One of the four best-effort LSP producers #4514 floors together: the gating step "LSP evaluated floor" in the same job reads their {producer, evaluated} records and the committed docs, and nightly-evaluated-floors pins that step, its position after this producer, and this step's continue-on-error.

A working-tree edit only the promotion PR below commits: a missing measurement summary clears the night memory and promotes nothing, and the idle-eviction measurement and its registry test read the tree this step would have changed.
A cache-write step (mode: save), the same shape as the cache save in parser-smoke.yml: the graded layers above it carry the verdict, and losing the cache costs a cold install on the next night.

Fail-open doc bookkeeping: any error leaves master's capability matrix untouched and the step exits 0. Its loss is a stale bookkeeping row, never an unproven verdict, and the refresh guard above the PR writer reads the regenerated docs.

Tracker maintenance: issue upserts must never change the nightly's own conclusion. Each notifier reads a producer's staged outcome and log, so a failed producer is reported rather than gated here.
Tracker maintenance over the census outcome and job status (#4277): it reports the failure any of the inspected LSP steps produced, and gating the notifier would mask the census it exists to report.
Tracker maintenance over the measurement's drift state: the measurement and its registry test carry the verdict, and a missing state file leaves the issue as it is rather than reading clean.

Tracker maintenance over the clean-signal probe's summary: the probe's own continue-on-error outcome and the #4514 evaluated floor carry the verdict; this step only files, refreshes or closes the #594 issue.

Tracker maintenance over the probe's stale-cell verdict (#4512): the probe, the matrix refresh and tests/scripts/lsp-matrix-refresh-expiry.test.ts carry the verdict, and a missing verdict file leaves the issue as it is rather than reading clean.
Tracker maintenance over the six gating layer outcomes (#2723): it reports a red the non-continue-on-error layers already produced, so gating the notifier itself would only hide that verdict.

PR plumbing, not a producer (#4512): it runs only for a refresh the non-continue-on-error 'Refuse a degraded refresh' guard passed and the flip check found flip-free, and a failed arming shows as this step's own outcome with the PR left for a maintainer.

Token plumbing, not a producer (#4512): when the App is absent or the mint fails the refresh PR falls back to the repository token, which the PR body states, and a failed mint shows as this step's own outcome.

PR plumbing, not a producer: 'Refuse a degraded refresh (regenerated docs against HEAD)' above it is the gate and is not continue-on-error, so a degraded night never reaches this writer, and a copy failure shows as this step's own outcome.

PR plumbing, not a producer: it opens only for a promotion the measurement step proposed, and the same job's non-continue-on-error refresh guard reads the docs the measurement wrote before either PR step runs.

.github/workflows/untriaged-issues.yml#d.reason: An advisory reporter, not a producer (#4691, #4989 r3): scripts/check-ci-job-p90.mjs prints one ::warning annotation per job over the ratio and one per required context it could not measure, and exits 1 only when its data read failed, so a blown read (a GitHub 502, run 40690133466) is visible in the run log and as this step's own failed outcome without reddening the nightly. The job's verdict is the untriaged-issue detector below it, which is not continue-on-error and still reds the job.

.github/workflows/tool-smoke.yml#tool-sm.reason: JDK 25 install for the jdtls cascade row, not a producer: an absent JDK leaves JAVA_HOME empty, jdtls 1.63.0 cannot resolve its bundles on the job's JDK 21, and the "LSP cascade layer" step in the same job reds on the java row (a provisioned server that never answers), so an install that silently did nothing cannot read green.

jdtls install for the cascade row, not a producer: a failed download or digest check leaves the step output path empty, the "LSP cascade layer" step in the same job reads java as not provisioned (a warning row), and its --min-pass floor of 3 of 4 still reds the night when the other servers do not prove the lane, so an install that silently did nothing cannot read green.
